Messages.Author: Derek Huisjen
Messages.Body:
My fellow Methuselahs and I have been trying to figure out
the retainer rules for quite some time. When damage is
dealt at short range, who chooses who takes the damage?
We have been playing that the player with the retainer
can put the damage on their retainer (like 1 pt on the
wolf), instead of taking it themself. Is this correct?
(Like the wolf acts as sort of a flak jacket).
Help appreciated! Thanks...

--Derek

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
dhui...@ursa.calvin.edu (Derek Huisjen) writes:



Non-ranged damage is applied to the minion - never the retainer
(unless a retainer card stated otherwise, of course)

Ranged (R) damage, even dealt at close range, can target either
the minion or any retainer - as chosen by the minion dealing
the damage.

L. Scott
